title: mcp
description: Search thousands of active YouTube sponsors and 60,000+ channels from any MCP client. Free tier.
summary: Search thousands of active YouTube sponsors and 60,000+ channels from any MCP client. Free tier.
offersHint: Search thousands of active YouTube sponsors and 60,000+ channels from any MCP client. Free tier. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.meetsponsors.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: sponsor_search
toolsPreview.description: Search sponsors by name, description, industry tags, or filters. Returns compact results (id, name, website, niches, industryTags, country, operations, medianSubscribers). Use sponsor_get for full detail on a specific sponsor.

toolsPreview.name: sponsor_get
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed information about a specific sponsor by ID. Strips raw scrape data and llm internal analysis blobs.

toolsPreview.name: sponsor_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get statistics for a sponsor: number of YouTubers, median subscribers, operations per week/month/year

toolsPreview.name: sponsor_similar
toolsPreview.description: Find sponsors similar to a given sponsor based on industry tags and niches. Returns compact format.

toolsPreview.name: sponsor_youtubers
toolsPreview.description: Get YouTubers who have worked with a sponsor. Returns compact format.

toolsPreview.name: sponsor_mostActive
toolsPreview.description: Get the most active sponsors in a given period (week/month/year), optionally filtered by language or sponsoring kind. Returns compact format.

toolsPreview.name: sponsor_recentVideos
toolsPreview.description: Get the most recent sponsored videos from a sponsor, ordered by publication date

toolsPreview.name: sponsor_recentCollaborations
toolsPreview.description: Get the most recent collaboration (one video per YouTuber) with a sponsor, sorted by publication date

toolsPreview.name: youtuber_search
toolsPreview.description: Search YouTubers with advanced filters: subscribers, language, niches, sponsors worked with, monthly frequency, etc. Returns compact results. Use youtuber_get for full detail.

toolsPreview.name: youtuber_get
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed information about a specific YouTuber by their YouTube channel ID. Includes llmDescription and llmSponsorProfile (LLM-friendly summaries).

toolsPreview.name: youtuber_sponsors
toolsPreview.description: Get sponsors a YouTuber has worked with, including video counts for each sponsor. Returns compact format.

toolsPreview.name: youtuber_recentSponsored
toolsPreview.description: Get the most recent sponsored videos from a YouTuber, with one video per sponsor (sorted by publication date)

toolsPreview.name: youtuber_similar
toolsPreview.description: Find YouTubers similar to a given YouTuber based on content, niches, and sponsors. Returns compact format.

toolsPreview.name: youtuber_lastActiveBiggest
toolsPreview.description: Get the biggest YouTubers who have been active recently (last 15 days) for a specific language. Returns compact format.

toolsPreview.name: youtuber_add
toolsPreview.description: Add a single YouTuber to the database and trigger the full enrichment pipeline (tags, niches, description, similarity, sponsor detection). Returns a batchId you can poll with import_status. Prefer passing a channel ID (UCxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx, 24 chars) — handles ('@xxx') and URLs work too but cost an extra YouTube API quota point per call to resolve.

toolsPreview.name: youtuber_bulk_add
toolsPreview.description: Add up to 50 YouTubers in one call and trigger enrichment for each. Returns a batchId you can poll with import_status. Strongly prefer channel IDs (UCxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx, 24 chars) over handles/URLs — handles cost an extra YouTube API quota point each, which depletes the daily 10k budget faster.

toolsPreview.name: import_status
toolsPreview.description: Poll the progress of a bulk import batch by its batchId. Returns total/queued/done/failed counts plus startedAt/finishedAt timestamps. Batches expire after 7 days.
